title: Power Platform governance: multi-grader comparison for agent evaluations
summary: Pass with a descriptive gap: Microsoft has not established that multi-grader comparison displays agent responses, although the roadmap does promise supporting evidence. The existing-evaluation controls are documented; minor corrections should complete the navigation, qualify the signed-in-profile statement and change the action rating to review.

claims.claim: Existing comparison is reached at agent > Evaluation > Recent test results > test run > Compare with > comparison run.
claims.quote:
In your agent's Evaluation page, under Recent test results, open the test run you want to use as the base for the comparison.
Select the Compare with dropdown, and then select the time and date of the test run you want to compare with the currently open test results.
claims.fix: Use 'Agents > agent > Evaluation > Recent test results > test run > Compare with > comparison run' in the front matter and table. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/agents-page, which documents selecting Agents in the side pane and the agent name to open it. 'comparison run' is a valid placeholder, not a missing label.

claims.claim: The printed Power Platform API POST operation runs an existing evaluation test set.
claims.quote:
POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/environments/{EnvironmentId}/bots/{BotId}/api/makerevaluation/testsets/{TestSetId}/run?api-version=2024-10-01
Purpose: Run an evaluation for a test set by using the test set's id.

claims.claim: GET of the evaluation testruns/{TestRunId} resource returns run details and results.
claims.quote:
GET https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/environments/{EnvironmentId}/bots/{BotId}/api/makerevaluation/testruns/{TestRunId}?api-version=2024-10-01
Purpose: Retrieve the details of an evaluation by using the runId for your target evaluation run.

claims.where: Governance controls: connector data policy paragraph
claims.claim: Blocking the Microsoft Copilot Studio connection prevents existing authenticated evaluations.
claims.quote: Agent evaluations that use user authentication require access through the Microsoft Copilot Studio connector. If your admin turns off this connection, you can't run tests by using the evaluation tool.

claims.quote:

Select Data policy. The Data policies list appears.
claims.fix: Replace 'The data policy is set in the Power Platform admin center under Security > Data and privacy > Data policy' with 'Existing data policies are listed at Power Platform admin center > Security > Data and privacy > Data policy'. The printed path correctly reaches the list, not the connector configuration.

claims.claim: The linked evaluation-methods page lists available graders for existing evaluations.
claims.quote: When you create test sets, choose from different test methods to evaluate your agent's responses. Each test method has its own strengths and suits different types of evaluations.

claims.claim: An action rating of none fits the advice to decide which graders to trust and pilot the comparison before changing release criteria.
claims.quote:
action: "none"
Define which graders your team already trusts.
Use comparison on a pilot test set before changing release criteria.
claims.fix: Set action to 'review'. The standard assigns review to an optional capability needing a fit decision; none means awareness only, with nothing to configure or decide.
